title: UPDATE: teleoperator v2 is out: cops, tuning, multiplayer races, and AI-generated cars
author: marina_sd20
selftext:
last week i posted here asking where to take my robotaxi game. thanks to everyone who chimed in, it really helped!

here’s what’s new:

* earn running deliveries
* get busted by police
* tune your car
* multiplayer races with your friends
* generate your own cars

would love to hear what you think. it still needs improvements, so any feedback is appreciated!

game link: [teleoperator.mindblown.ai](http://teleoperator.mindblown.ai)

comments.author: n3ul1ng
comments.body: wow sick! is the world pre-generated or procedural?

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: thanks! a mix of both. street layout comes from openstreetmap, and the city is procedurally built

replies.author: n3ul1ng
replies.body: smart! need to think of this for my next map layout. never thought about inherit from open street maps or similar.

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: highly recommend it, saves a ton of work

comments.author: Super_Range45
comments.body: Looks cool. Imo having cops pin your car should trigger a fail state if you can't get moving promptly.

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: good call, that'd make the chases way more tense. adding it to the list, thanks!

comments.author: LowenbrauDel
comments.body: I misread the title as 'teleportator' and expected some mechanics with car teleportation. If I am to be honest.

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: you can actually teleport in the game. just open the map in the lower left corner, pick a spot, and keep driving or racing from there

comments.author: Strict_Indication457
comments.body: are the cars and assets all ai generated or did you get them from somewhere? looks really good

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: thanks! mostly AI-generated, my mindblown AI agent had blender and 3d model gen to work with. but the ferrari one’s from the three.js examples. you can also generate your own car in this version

replies.author: marina_sd20
replies.body: i used the mindblown dot ai game maker

comments.author: sunole123
comments.body: i am not a gamer, i think but a good sign for a game is when later you think about it, this game did this, and i came back tonight to it, and mind blows found the pedestrians and i got busted by the police, my mind is blown, the realism of the city and the NPC is just surprisingly appealing to me,
